content: If you close key setup now, the recovery phrase shown here will not be valid. You will get a new one when you start again.

comment.text: Text of the confirmation that asks whether to close the key setup dialog while it shows the 24-word recovery phrase at its last step: closing discards the key that phrase belongs to, so the shown phrase will not work and a new one is made when key setup starts again.
